pre_execution_defects_caught_and_repaire.defect: The initial calibration runner regenerated all 432 A4.4a case records and only then filtered to the 288 calibration rows. It would not have scored validation, but this was weaker than the required unopened-validation boundary.

Validation case records are never materialized by A4.4c. The resulting 288-row calibration surface was hashed and frozen before inference.
